title.en: Story 11 — The Death of a Clerk

book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: موظف صغير راح عالمسرح وهو مبسوط.
sentences.en: A small clerk went to the theatre in good spirits.
In the middle of the performance, he sneezed suddenly.
In front of him sat an important general.
The clerk leaned forward and said: I beg your pardon.

sentences.ar: الجنرال قال: عادي، ما في إشي.
sentences.en: The general said: it is nothing.

sentences.ar: بس الموظف حس إنه ما اقتنع.
sentences.en: But the clerk felt he had not been convinced.
At the interval, he apologised again.
The next day, he went to the office and apologised.
And the day after, he came back again.

sentences.ar: بالآخر، الجنرال صرخ فيه: اطلع برا!
sentences.en: In the end, the general shouted at him: get out!
The clerk went home and lay down on the sofa.
And he did not get up.
